lessons.title: Never reuse a numeric bar from a prior card without re-deriving reachability for the new target
lessons.statement: z_hyp G_fit inherited Arm B dehydron S1-shaped lift≥1.30 without checking SDRP majority geometry. With maj≈0.85–0.96, max lift at acc=1 is ≈1.04–1.18 — bar 1.30 was STRUCTURALLY_UNREACHABLE by construction. Locked-card binary still stands; scientific read must not treat the miss as architecture incapacity.
lessons.process_gap: reuse the numeric bar from a prior card without checking it is reachable for the new target's label geometry

lessons.title: Separate wiring gates from capacity bars before reading either
lessons.statement: Dehydron INSTR spine 0/0 made capacity unreadable. z_hyp SDRP-live cleared G_grad_spine at 12-fold scale then failed locked capacity under cold-lite/400/MoE-ablated — first trustworthy separation on this line.

lessons.title: Clip pressure follows concentrated Euclidean grads, not 'more modules have gradient'
lessons.statement: Dehydron preclip 2.75 came from two MLPs; spine reconnect spread signal and clip_active_fraction stayed 0 (max preclip~0.74).

lessons.title: SDRP argmax minority emptiness is R0/R1 count geometry, not R5 crowding
lessons.statement: Even with R5 fully removed, salt/hydrophobe winners stay nearly empty and majority shifts to SDRP_CORE from R0/R1. Further edge-threshold tweaks cannot rescue an inherited lift≥1.30 bar on these folds; redesign metric or target instead.

lessons.title: Single-structure grad probes are measurement noise, not model noise
lessons.statement: wrap1_zhyp logger's every-10-step bucket_grad_l2 used a second SDRP backward on train_batches[0] while Adam averaged 11 structures. Projector sawtooth was primarily that measurement mismatch. Next harness card must log grads from the train backward itself.
lessons.process_gap: treat probe-curve shape as model dynamics without checking whether the probe matches the train backward

lessons.title: This line's recent findings are measurement corrections, not architecture verdicts
lessons.statement: Pooled AUPRC, dehydron-off-spine, unreachable lift bars, mean-only F1, and 3-not-5 effective SDRP classes were instrument/scope failures. SDRP-live spine reach is confirmed wiring. Do not redesign architecture while moe/euc_skip/minority-fit questions still have unsigned measurement in front of them — land instruments, run one clean capacity card, then decide.
lessons.process_gap: treat INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT or low moe grad as architecture incapacity before instruments are trustworthy
